name: Bretesuchus
sum: Bretesuchus is a large sebecid apex predator of about 4 m from the Paleocene Maíz Gordo Formation of north-western Argentina.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; named by Gasparini et al. in 1993 from the El Brete locality.
material: Fossils from the El Brete locality, Maíz Gordo Formation.
biology: A large apex predator; the sources consulted give no further direct evidence of habits.
author: Gasparini et al. 1993

sources.text: Gasparini, Zulma; Fernandez, Marta; Powell, Jaime E. 1993. New Tertiary sebecosuchians (Crocodylomorpha) from South America: phylogenetic implications. Historical Biology 7: 1–19. doi:10.1080/10292389309380440
